decision_rule.hypothesis: A standing observed enemy tower keeps its hero target until invalid/out of range. A red hero belowhalfHP that continues attacking such a tower may die before converting it, even when allied creeps arrive. Briefly move outside tower range to shed the target, then resume normal play immediately when the observed tower changes target; preserve near-finished towers. Guarded handoff requires a living allied creep witness within4 public tiles of that tower. Test standalone red handoff and coordinated handoff/current-three-defender blue behavior; test unguarded red release separately as a combined variant.
decision_rule.observed_counterexample: Local winning DeathKnight also tanks atlowHP with no nearby creep, so blanket escape is not presumed good. Broad danger escapes failed older studies. Currentduty3 16/16local fails119>118.45survival; this is a changed candidate, not a relaxed gate.
